items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I almost forgot about them when I saw them in John Baker's home.

ctx.x: Well I thought it was a good idea, because Capital has been very good to me. All the faculty, the deans, and the president, just everybody, and I've enjoyed it. It's a very good music school and intimate it is, and it's a good school of learning, and I suggested this idea of doing, running these pictures for about two and a half hours, and we presented it to the president here, and he just loved the idea, and so that's what they're going to do.
And John Baker's supplying the film.
That's right, mmm hmmm. And so....
